title: Micronaut
description: Pattern-bound continuation with memory, WCR state, and callable edges. §61: Micronaut = Pattern + Guard + Continuation + Edges + WCR.

patterns.description: Pattern strings matched against query scrutinee (§56-§60 pattern hierarchy)

guards.description: Threshold guards applied after pattern match (e.g. 'confidence > 0.6')

continuations.description: Named operations executed when this micronaut is selected

callableEdges.description: Micronauts this one may invoke (Xul-promoted callable edges only)

semanticEdges.description: Related concepts/domains (inference only; NOT callable without promotion)

domainField.description: Optional: domain field this micronaut emerged from

x-khanary-law: Micronaut=Pattern-Bound Continuation. µ.pattern=SNOBOL value+WCR. µ.continuation=AIML template+callable route.
x-khanary-edge-law: semantic_edge ≠ callable_edge. Promotion requires Xul gate (requirePromotion=true).
